g.text: RECOVERY RAIL:5.270V analog clamp, timed latch-off

g.desc: RECOVERY RAIL:5.270V analog clamp, timed latch-off

g.text: DEVELOPMENT: low-VCC FB accuracy, hot SOA and actual loads remain unqualified.

g.desc: DEVELOPMENT: low-VCC FB accuracy, hot SOA and actual loads remain unqualified.

g.text: HGATE support / gate-source clamps / controlled startup

g.desc: HGATE support / gate-source clamps / controlled startup

g.text: Three FETs per function reduce loss; equal linear-fault sharing is not assumed.

g.desc: Three FETs per function reduce loss; equal linear-fault sharing is not assumed.

g.text: 5V0_RECOVERY_REG is actual converter output; converter FB and RAW bank stay UPSTREAM.

g.desc: 5V0_RECOVERY_REG is actual converter output; converter FB and RAW bank stay UPSTREAM.

g.text: R625=330ohm bleed; C632=100nF timer; C626=10nF gate slew; R617/R618=3.57k/1.11k.

g.desc: R625=330ohm bleed; C632=100nF timer; C626=10nF gate slew; R617/R618=3.57k/1.11k.

g.text: Require5ms heavy-load admission plus20ms settling and local rail qualification.

g.desc: Require5ms heavy-load admission plus20ms settling and local rail qualification.

g.text: 2ms UV reset never bypasses cooldown:>=10s development wait; restore<=0.5A startup state.

g.desc: 2ms UV reset never bypasses cooldown:>=10s development wait; restore<=0.5A startup state.

g.text: INTEGRATION IS NOT QUALIFICATION. Low-VCC clamp accuracy and hot linear SOA remain conditional.

g.desc: INTEGRATION IS NOT QUALIFICATION. Low-VCC clamp accuracy and hot linear SOA remain conditional.

g.text: Autonomous3V3 OV containment is absent. S03/S11 API limitations and reused-part review gates remain open.

g.desc: Autonomous3V3 OV containment is absent. S03/S11 API limitations and reused-part review gates remain open.

g.text: REC5_FAULT:active-low global to MCU PA7; single47k R619 pullup to essential+3V3.

g.desc: REC5_FAULT:active-low global to MCU PA7; single47k R619 pullup to essential+3V3.

g.text: SHDN/ENOUT intentionally NC. Reset PA6 acts through47k R623 and Q609.

g.desc: SHDN/ENOUT intentionally NC. Reset PA6 acts through47k R623 and Q609.

g.text: Require>=112uF bulk /<=0.4ohm cold and>=48uF low-ESR ceramic;external<=100uF.

g.desc: Require>=112uF bulk /<=0.4ohm cold and>=48uF low-ESR ceramic;external<=100uF.

g.text: Actual cap/magnetic/pulse/source bounds and consumer voltage-time limits remain open.

g.desc: Actual cap/magnetic/pulse/source bounds and consumer voltage-time limits remain open.
